attribute_information.block: Field is split into blocks to minimize the effects of spatial variability. Block number represents which block this replicate/plot is contained in.
attribute_information.cc_treatment: Describes which cover crop treatment is used on the plot prior to the main crops
attribute_information.cob_num: Number of sweet corn cobs harvested from two 4 m rows of sweet corn.
attribute_information.mositure_treatment: Describes whether a plot was in the drought or ambient conditions treatment
attribute_information.plot: Describes the plot that a replicate was grown in.
attribute_information.soil_dw: Soil weight (grams) of dried soil minus the container weight.
attribute_information.soil_grav_moist: Gravimetric moisture content of the soil expressed as a percentage.
attribute_information.soil_ww: Soil weight (grams) of unaltered soil for the field site
attribute_information.tin_w: Weight of the container (grams) that wet soil is being dried in. Subtracted from dry soil measurement.
attribute_information.yield: Sweet corn yield (Mt/Ha). The weight of sweet corn harvested from two 4 m rows was extrapolated.

meta.description: This research is examining the effects of long-term cover cropping on soil microbial communities and sweet corn microbial recruitment during short-term drought. This will be used to determine if either the management practice and/or potential microbial changes offer the sweet corn any type of yield protection.
meta.name: UNIV6020_RDM_Hornick-Martyk
